messages.content: Implement a card-game bot that uses the first non-empty visible hand (the normal hand, then face-up off-hand cards), filters it to cards whose ranks are currently playable, and returns a random valid choice. Return undefined when no visible card is playable; once visible cards are exhausted, return the first available face-down card. Existing Card, Cards, Pile, Player, getRank, and playableCards definitions are available from ./lib.

instruction: Implement a card-game bot that prioritizes visible cards, randomly selects a legal rank, and falls back to the first face-down card only when visible cards are exhausted.

messages.content: Implement the pile rule for deciding whether a card can be played: ranks 2 and 8 are always legal, rank 8 on top is transparent when finding the effective top card, an empty effective pile accepts any card, rank 7 requires the new rank to be no higher than 7, and all other top cards require an equal-or-higher rank. Existing Card, Pile, Rank, and getRank definitions are available.

instruction: Implement special-card and effective-top-card rules for legal plays on a card pile.

messages.content: Implement dealHand for a side deck using the supplied RNG. Shuffle a copy without mutating the input, select up to four cards with distinct card codes first, and if fewer than four distinct cards exist, cycle through the shuffled cards until the hand has four cards. Return an empty hand when the deck is empty. Rng exposes shuffle(array), SideCard exposes code, and HAND_SIZE is 4.

instruction: Deal a four-card side hand while preferring unique card codes and preserving the input deck.

messages.content: Define five campaign AI deck tiers as ordered card-code lists and implement aiDeck(tierIndex) to resolve every code into a SideCard. Preserve tier order and duplicates and throw an error when the index is outside the configured tiers. A card(code) resolver and SideCard type already exist.

instruction: Implement fixed campaign AI decks with tier lookup, code resolution, and invalid-index handling.

messages.content: Inside a ComputerPlayer class, implement tactical target helpers that find the closest enemy unit, return movement cells that are walkable and not occupied by friendly units, choose the cell with the minimum squared distance from a unit, and return attack-range cells occupied by opponents after switching the selection manager to attack mode. The class already exposes board, mask, and selectionManger; Unit, Cell, and PathNodeComponent are available.

instruction: Implement the movement and target-selection helpers for a turn-based enemy player.

messages.content: Implement forward and inverse coordinate transforms between a square grid and an isometric screen. Use half tile width and half tile height, horizontally center the diamond using the map width, and return x/y coordinates for both grid-to-screen and screen-to-grid conversion. Existing GridCoordinates, ScreenCoordinates, Size2D, and constants.tileSize definitions are available.

instruction: Implement reversible grid/isometric-screen coordinate conversion for a tactics map.

messages.content: Inside an abstract Phaser tower Gun class, implement update(delta) so it clears dead targets, reacquires the nearest enemy, predicts target position from velocity and frame delta, rotates along the shorter angular direction, and fires only when aim error is within ten degrees and cooldown has elapsed. Reset cooldown after firing and stop rotation when aligned or idle. The class already exposes scene, sprite, aimingAt, gunParams, coolDown, generateBullets, and Phaser Vector2.

instruction: Implement predictive targeting, shortest-path rotation, and cooldown-based firing for a tower gun.

quality.warning: Source project requires a legacy OpenSSL compatibility flag to build on Node 24.
